intro: Eating disorders are serious, treatable mental illnesses, and your role is to notice changes, offer kind support and encourage professional help.
points: Eating disorders carry one of the highest risks to life, so treat any sign of physical distress as urgent.
This course builds awareness only — you notice, support kindly and escalate, but never diagnose, assess or treat.
Someone can be critically unwell at any weight, so never judge how ill a person is by their appearance.
Anyone can be affected — any age, gender, body or background — so stay alert with everyone in your care.
At mealtimes follow the person's care plan, keep things calm, and encourage gently without ever forcing food or drink.
Avoid comments on weight, size or eating — even praise — and encourage the person early towards their GP or Beat.
